hero.title: Start with your business goal. Yellowmind shows the way through.
hero.description: Begin in conversation, connect the right knowledge and specialists, then turn useful work into governed execution you can inspect and repeat.
hero.assurance: Yellowmind keeps evidence close to the answer so people can judge reliability before acting.
goals.title: What do you need to accomplish?
goals.description: Choose an outcome. Yellowmind takes you to the best starting point and shows the capability chain behind it.
goal.answer.title: Answer a business question
goal.answer.description: Explore a question across approved knowledge and turn evidence into a decision.
goal.knowledge.title: Build a trusted knowledge foundation
goal.knowledge.description: Organize documents, shared context, and business meaning for people and AI.
goal.knowledge.chain: Workspace → semantic model → grounded AI work
goal.automate.title: Automate a repeatable process
goal.automate.description: Turn successful work into a controlled sequence of agent tasks and approvals.
goal.govern.title: Govern trusted outcomes
goal.govern.description: Control readiness, access, publication, and oversight before AI-assisted work becomes business action.
trust.title: Confidence is inspectable, not implied.
trust.description: When evaluation is available, Yellowmind brings reliability evidence into the response instead of asking people to trust AI output at face value.
trust.score.title: Reliability signal
trust.score.description: See the available evaluation and its confidence before relying on an answer.
trust.claims.title: Claim-level evidence
trust.claims.description: Inspect which claims are supported, partially supported, unsupported, or contradicted.
trust.audit.title: Auditable work
trust.audit.description: Trace sources, execution, approvals, and decisions across governed AI work.
journey.title: One connected path from question to governed outcome
journey.description: Each capability has a clear role. Start where the work begins and move forward only when the goal requires it.
journey.conversation.title: Begin in conversation
journey.conversation.description: Describe the business goal, explore the problem, and shape the useful result before choosing more machinery.
journey.context.title: Ground the work in trusted context
journey.context.description: Use workspaces for approved sources and semantic models for shared business meaning when your role provides access.
journey.automate.title: Make useful work repeatable
journey.automate.description: Use agents for specialist work and Playbooks for controlled execution, schedules, approvals, and visible progress.
journey.governance.title: Keep outcomes controlled and accountable
journey.governance.description: Review evidence, policies, execution history, and oversight before AI-assisted work becomes business action.
quick.title: Return to work quickly
quick.description: Direct access for familiar users without turning this overview into a full workbench.
authorizations.title: Connected apps enable work; they are not the work itself.
authorizations.description: Authorize access to external tools so agents can act with your delegated credentials. Apps published from conversations are available in the marketplace.
